patterns.title: Legacy Code Modernization
patterns.problem: Monolithic functions with high cyclomatic complexity and no tests.
patterns.solution: 1. Write characterization tests. 2. Apply 'Extract Method' to break down large functions. 3. Introduce strict typing (TypeScript). 4. Refactor control flow. 5. Verify with tests.
patterns.author: Senior Dev

patterns.title: Refatoração para Micro-módulos (Holonic)
patterns.problem: Código acoplado que dificulta a reutilização por agentes/holons específicos.
patterns.solution: 1. Identificar responsabilidades isoladas (Single Responsibility Principle). 2. Extrair lógica para módulos independentes em `packages/cli/modules`. 3. Definir interfaces claras de entrada/saída. 4. Documentar com AI-DOC para ingestão automática. 5. Publicar como ferramenta MCP se aplicável.
patterns.author: Architect Agent

patterns.title: Callback to Async/Await Migration
patterns.problem: Deeply nested callbacks (callback hell) making code unreadable and hard to debug.
patterns.solution: 1. Identify callback-based functions. 2. Wrap them in util.promisify or rewrite to return Promises. 3. Replace .then().catch() chains with try/catch blocks using await. 4. Ensure error propagation is preserved.
patterns.author: Senior Dev
